title: Valuation topology on the integers of a finite p-adic coefficient extension
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with its extending absolute value $|\cdot|_E$ and ring of integers $O=\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Define the valuation topology on $O$ to be the topology induced by the inclusion $O\hookrightarrow E$, where $E$ has the metric topology of $|\cdot|_E$.

source.place: Finite free and finitely presented coefficient extensions: exactness of the condensed finite free resolution of a finite O_E-algebra
